items.title: Guided project discovery
items.rationale: Source-backed planning exists; adaptive 5-7 question rounds, gap-only brownfield discovery and answer capsules are not implemented.
items.v112Insufficient: No complete guided interview/mode-selection flow or preserved answer capsule spans new and existing projects.

items.title: Canonical project planning
items.rationale: Canonical artifacts, contracts and scoped packs exist; an integrated owner-change impact and critical-path completeness experience is not evidenced.
items.v112Insufficient: No complete impact traversal spans requirements, architecture, security, deployment, test and proof decisions.

items.title: Approved visual experience
items.rationale: Applies only to owner-confirmed products with UI; V1.1.2 has no visual design factory.
items.v112Insufficient: No wireflow, semantic design tokens, responsive states or visual/accessibility proof engine; UI-free apps must not receive it.

items.title: Marathon execution and critical path
items.rationale: Dependency-ordered packs, exact checkpoints and resume logic exist; long-running multi-wave operator coordination remains a proposal.
items.v112Insufficient: No admitted multi-wave orchestration with owner feedback and bounded stop/resume across long Work Orders.

items.title: Bug Hunter and requirement/invariant proof
items.rationale: Contract evidence, proof graph and conservative impact selection exist; generated hypotheses, selective mutation and domain-aware bug hunting are not one current feature.
items.v112Insufficient: No hypothesis-to-invariant-to-targeted-mutation loop or profile-specific adapter exists.

items.title: Delta Assurance, causal repair and flake control
items.rationale: Delta evidence and exact invalidation exist; flake registry, causal repair and blinded comparisons remain proposals.
items.v112Insufficient: No cross-run flake registry or causal-repair workflow; neither may weaken risk floors or final proof.

items.title: Autonomous review and evidence
items.rationale: Evidence chains exist but do not establish independent review. Owner semantic audit remains NOT_INDEPENDENT.
items.v112Insufficient: No governed independent exact-head reviewer or specialist-review routing; Codex self-report is not independence.

items.title: Engineering Intelligence
current: M22 estimates and selected CI receipts
items.rationale: Comparable latency and ROI verdict exist; tokens, task costs, escaped defects and calibrated confidence are unavailable.
items.v112Insufficient: No broad observable quality/cost/speed dataset or comparable cohort supports the full proposal.

items.title: Always-on truthful operator reporting
items.rationale: Machine-readable status and estimate primitives exist; complete pt-BR turn-level response is not verified as always-on.
items.v112Insufficient: No full status response on every substantive turn or reliable ETA without comparable samples.

items.title: Default installer and profile router
items.rationale: Profile and brownfield lifecycle commands exist; verified stack/domain detection, cost/entitlement doctor and installable sample are incomplete.
items.v112Insufficient: No versioned router combines owner-confirmed domains, reversible per-target tools and verified cross-platform sample.

items.title: Release and reproducibility
items.rationale: Package release path exists; cross-application build-once/proof-many and reproducible app-profile evidence are not demonstrated.
items.v112Insufficient: Accepted release proves the CLI artifact, not general artifact sharing across heterogeneous profiles.

items.title: Operations feedback
current: M43/M44/M61 generic observability, audit and runbook primitives
items.rationale: Only where the approved app DoD includes deployment; no hosted GEF runtime is required.
items.v112Insufficient: No deployed-app SLO, privacy-safe reproduction and release-to-regression loop is provided by generic evidence primitives.

items.title: Web frontend/API
items.rationale: Only for an approved web/API target; UI-free APIs do not need browser tooling.
items.v112Insufficient: No API compatibility/adversarial/browser/accessibility/preview profile exists.

items.title: Data-heavy application
items.rationale: Only where owner-confirmed data and recovery requirements require it.
items.v112Insufficient: No disposable migration, data invariant, tenant isolation or restore/RPO/RTO adapter.

items.title: SaaS subscription and usage
items.rationale: Only for a subscription/usage product; simple SaaS does not automatically get a money-moving ledger.
items.v112Insufficient: No billing, signed/idempotent webhook, entitlement, refund or finance-reconciliation contract.

items.title: SaaS enterprise and tenant governance
items.rationale: Only for multi-tenant enterprise needs explicitly selected by the owner.
items.v112Insufficient: No end-to-end tenant isolation, lifecycle, redaction, SSO/SCIM or data-plane proof profile.

items.title: Financial value movement
items.rationale: Only for credits, balances, escrow, marketplaces or payouts; HIGH_ASSURANCE; owner-authorized with specialist trigger unresolved.
items.v112Insufficient: No financial ledger, idempotent transfer, reconciliation or segregation proof.

items.title: Web3 EVM
items.rationale: Requires confirmed chain/product; HIGH_ASSURANCE for signing/deployment/assets. No mainnet action implied.
items.v112Insufficient: No Solidity/Foundry, chain identity, signer, reorg, ABI/storage or contract security adapter.

items.title: Web3 Solana
items.rationale: Requires an approved target and separately validated adapter; other-chain support does not imply this profile.
items.v112Insufficient: No Rust/Anchor, account/PDA/CPI, program-upgrade adapter or chain-specific tests.

items.title: Web3 data security
current: generic secrets, policy, audit and evidence safeguards
items.rationale: Only for an approved chain product handling protected data/keys; HIGH_ASSURANCE. Cryptographic options remain research unless admitted.
items.v112Insufficient: No product-specific key lifecycle, signing-intent, metadata privacy or cross-role custody controls.

items.title: Game 2D/3D
current: generic project profiles, planning and adoption
items.rationale: Only for an owner-selected game target with accepted engine/art/licensing constraints.
items.v112Insufficient: No playable slice, asset pipeline, engine decision, frame budget or visual playtest profile.

items.title: Game multiplayer/MMO
items.rationale: Only where the selected game requires authoritative multiplayer; single-player does not inherit this burden.
items.v112Insufficient: No authoritative server, reconnect/loss replay, anti-cheat or measured capacity profile.

items.title: Game plus Web3
current: generic project, security and evidence primitives
items.rationale: Only if justified by an approved product; game state stays distinct from settlement; no universal token/NFT requirement.
items.v112Insufficient: No cross-boundary idempotency/finality/reorg or inventory-consistency proof.

items.title: AI-native target app
current: generic security, policy and test proof
items.rationale: Only for an approved AI-dependent app; ordinary apps remain free of runtime AI dependencies.
items.v112Insufficient: No model/prompt/tool schema, evaluation, injection/exfiltration, per-tenant quota or model-change regression profile.

items.title: Formal, symbolic and deep fuzz proof
items.rationale: Research track, not a universal blocker; automated scans are not qualified external assurance.
items.v112Insufficient: No admitted workload, proof obligation or measured ROI justifies a campaign.

items.title: Advanced cryptography and custody research
items.rationale: ZK/FHE/TEE/MPC/post-quantum work remains experimental and protocol-dependent.
items.v112Insufficient: No accepted product requirement, compatible protocol or independently proven implementation is selected.

items.title: Enterprise-scale always-on operations
current: local-first status, evidence and runbook foundations
items.rationale: 24/7 multi-region, all-chain, global MMO and paid remote services lack an accepted workload.
items.v112Insufficient: No customer SLO, capacity evidence or owner-approved spend supports these commitments.

items.title: Regulated operations and jurisdictional tax
items.rationale: Country-specific tax, regulated operations and certifications need explicit scope and qualified review.
items.v112Insufficient: No owner-approved jurisdiction, operating model or qualified professional authority exists in WO-000.

items.title: Framework, vendor and runner swaps
items.rationale: Tool replacement remains a hypothesis, not an unconditional migration.
items.v112Insufficient: Measured baseline reports no optimization benefit and no accepted tooling-swap ROI evidence.
